content:
Compass has delivered a very large 3 year share price gain, which puts fresh attention on whether the current US$10.61 price is supported by what the business is earning today. With that kind of move in the rear-view mirror, the key issue now is how the recent news flow lines up with the stock's earnings profile.

The share price return over the past 3 years is very large, so any mismatch between price and earnings power matters more for anyone thinking about new capital going into Compass now.

Compass is reporting multi billion dollar revenue, positive net income and higher adjusted EBITDA, which can shape how investors think about the durability and timing of the company's future earnings stream.

Your read on Compass is one view; the desks covering it have another. See what analysts think Compass's shares could be worth .

For investors, the debate is whether Compass's current share price is justified by its earnings when set against the Fair Ratio benchmark.

If you are weighing Compass against other opportunities built around earnings power and valuation checks, it can help to compare it with 36 high quality undervalued stocks .

Is Compass Getting Expensive on Earnings?

The P/E ratio fits Compass because investors are focused on how its reported net income compares with the current share price. On that metric, Compass trades on roughly 60.9x earnings, which is much higher than the Real Estate sector average of about 15.4x and also above the peer group on roughly 37.8x. That gap suggests buyers today are paying a richer price per dollar of earnings than they would for many similar businesses.

The Fair Ratio benchmark, which blends Compass specific factors like margins, growth expectations, size and risk, points to a lower P/E than where the stock trades now, so the current multiple screens as overvalued against that yardstick. Despite recent headlines around the Anywhere Real Estate merger and cost synergies, the present earnings multiple still implies a premium that assumes a lot about how the combined group will perform over time. Explore the numbers behind Compass's P/E valuation .

The Compass Narrative: What Would Justify Today's Price?

Narratives pick up where Compass' valuation questions leave off. They spell out which future paths for revenue, profitability and earnings would need to play out for the stock to be worth materially more or materially less than today's price, all laid out on Simply Wall St's Community page. Where a single ratio or valuation output gives one figure, these storylines describe the future that figure rests on so you can watch whether reality matches the script.

Bullish and bearish Narratives on Compass are reading the same facts and coming to sharply different conclusions about what the current multiple assumes.

The bullish analyst Narrative on Simply Wall St frames Compass as a platform play where tech and integration can shift the earnings mix.

"The roll out of the home platform across owned and franchise brands, with expectations for tens of thousands of agents to be on the system over the next year, opens up an underappreciated opportunity for Compass to earn more software and services revenue per agent and improve operating leverage as platform usage deepens…"

Discover why this Narrative puts Compass at 29% undervalued .

The bearish analyst Narrative on Simply Wall St leans into the legal and listing rule fights as the pressure point for Compass.

"Although Compass is rapidly integrating Anywhere and reporting higher actioned cost synergies, the widening conflict with major MLSs that refuse to relax listing rules risks constraining the exclusive inventory thesis that underpins those platform economics, which could limit the expected uplift to revenue and net margins…"

Explore why this Narrative puts Compass at 15% overvalued .

One more Compass check that sits beside the current price tag

There is one more lens that belongs next to Compass' current multiple: how professional forecasters map out revenue and earnings a few years from now, and how that picture lines up with today's valuation. Explore where analysts expect Compass to be in a few years .

chineseTitle: 指南针（COMP）的定价是否在其大发展后完美？
chineseSummary: Compass 的股价连续 3 年大幅上涨，这让人们重新关注该公司目前的盈利是否支持当前 10.61 美元的价格。随着这种变化的发生，现在的关键问题是最近的新闻流如何与该股的盈利状况相一致。过去三年的股价回报率非常高，因此价格和盈利能力之间的任何不匹配对于任何考虑将新资本注入康帕斯的人来说都更加重要......
chineseContent:
Compass 的股价连续 3 年大幅上涨，这让人们重新关注该公司目前的盈利是否支持当前 10.61 美元的价格。随着这种变化的发生，现在的关键问题是最近的新闻流如何与该股的盈利状况相一致。

过去三年的股价回报率非常高，因此价格和盈利能力之间的任何不匹配对于现在考虑将新资本注入康帕斯的人来说都更为重要。

Compass 报告了数十亿美元的收入、正净利润和更高的调整后 EBITDA，这可以影响投资者对公司未来盈利流的持久性和时间安排的看法。

你在指南针上读到的只是一种观点；覆盖它的桌子上还有另一张。看看分析师认为康帕斯股票的价值是多少。

对于投资者来说，争论的焦点是康帕斯目前的股价是否合理，以公平比率基准为基准。

如果您正在权衡 Compass 与围绕盈利能力和估值检查而建立的其他机会，它将它与 36 只高质量的被低估的股票进行比较会有所帮助。

Compass 的盈利是否变得昂贵？

市盈率适合康帕斯，因为投资者关注的是其报告的净利润与当前股价的比较。根据该指标，Compass 的市盈率约为 60.9 倍，远高于房地产行业约 15.4 倍的平均市盈率，也高于同行约 37.8 倍的市盈率。这一差距表明，如今的买家为每美元收益支付的价格比许多类似企业的价格更高。

公平比率基准融合了康帕斯的具体因素，如利润率、增长预期、规模和风险，表明该股的市盈率低于该股目前的交易水平，因此，按照该标准，目前的多重筛选被高估了。尽管最近出现了有关 Anywhere Real Estate 合并和成本协同效应的头条新闻，但目前的市盈率仍然意味着溢价，该溢价很大程度上取决于合并后的集团随着时间的推移将如何表现。探索 Compass 市盈率估值背后的数字。

指南针叙述：什么可以证明今天的价格合理？

叙述从康帕斯估值问题中断的地方开始。他们详细说明了未来的收入、盈利能力和盈利路径需要如何实现，才能让股票的价值大幅高于或大幅低于今天的价格，所有这些都列在 Simply Wall St 的社区页面上。当单一比率或估值输出给出一个数字时，这些故事情节描述了该数字所依赖的未来，以便您可以观察现实是否与剧本相符。

指南针上的看涨和看跌叙述解读了相同的事实，但对当前市盈率的假设得出了截然不同的结论。

Simply Wall St 上乐观的分析师 Narrative 将 Compass 视为一个平台游戏，其中技术和集成可以改变盈利结构。

“自有品牌和特许经营品牌推出家庭平台，预计明年将有数以万计的代理商加入该系统，这为 Compass 提供了一个未被充分重视的机会，即随着平台使用的加深，每位代理商可以赚取更多软件和服务收入，并提高运营杠杆……”

了解为什么此叙述将 Compass 的价值低估了 29%。

Simply Wall St 的看跌分析师 Narrative 倾向于将法律和上市规则之争视为 Compass 的压力点。

“尽管 Compass 正在迅速整合 Anywhere 并报告更高的行动成本协同效应，但与拒绝放宽上市规则的主要 MLS 之间日益扩大的冲突可能会限制支撑这些平台经济的独家库存理论，这可能会限制收入和净利润的预期提升……”

探索为什么这个叙述将 Compass 的估值高估了 15%。

当前价格标签旁边还有一张指南针检查表

除了康帕斯目前的市盈率之外，还有一个镜头：专业预测者如何规划几年后的收入和收益，以及该情况如何与今天的估值相符。探索分析师对 Compass 几年后的预期。
